description.value:
Your tinkering has given you a companion, a Steel Defender. You decide its appearance and whether it has two legs or four; your choices don't affect its game statistics. The defender is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys you; it vanishes if you die.

The Defender in Combat. In combat, the defender acts during your turn. It can move and take its Reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the Dodge action unless you take a Bonus Action to command it to take another action. If you have the Incapacitated condition, it acts on its own and isn't limited to the Dodge action.

Restoring or Replacing the Defender. If the defender died within the last hour, you can take a Magic action to touch it and expend a spell slot: it returns to life after 1 minute with all its Hit Points. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can create a new defender if you have Smith's Tools in hand; if you already have one, the first one vanishes.

Steel Defender. Medium Construct. AC 12 + your Intelligence modifier. Hit Points 5 + five times your Artificer level (Hit Dice: d8s equal to your Artificer level). Speed 40 ft. STR 14, DEX 12, CON 14, INT 4, WIS 10, CHA 6. Immunities Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. It understands the languages you know, and its Proficiency Bonus equals yours. Steel Bond: add your Proficiency Bonus to its ability checks and saving throws. Force-Empowered Rend: melee attack using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft., 1d8 + 2 plus your Intelligence modifier Force damage. Repair (3/Day): the defender, or a Construct or object it can see within 5 feet, regains 2d8 plus your Intelligence modifier Hit Points. Deflect Attack (Reaction): when a creature it can see within 5 feet attacks a different creature, the attacker has Disadvantage on that roll.

Foundry Note

The summon applies your Intelligence modifier to its AC, attack damage, and Repair, and five times your Artificer level to its Hit Points.

activation.condition: When you finish a Long Rest
